verdict.rationale: OpenTofu ships a first-party `tofu test` command that runs assertions against a configuration, creates its own temporary infrastructure, and destroys it when the test finishes. It also supports `.tofu`-specific test files and machine-readable JSON output for automation, and speculative `tofu plan` runs let developers check changes before review. The "without touching production" part is only implied, because tests still provision real resources and nothing documents isolating them from production. missing for 10: documented mocking/isolation from production environments (e.g. mock providers or plan-only test runs), independent or hands-on corroboration of the test workflow.
